# Fil Rouge Atelier

> Fictional demo business for a portfolio project. It offers car wraps, paint protection film, ceramic coating and window tint in Scottsdale, Arizona. Prices are sample prices.

## Services

- [Color change wrap](https://filrouge.example/color-wrap.html): from $3,200, usually 3–4 days. Chrome delete from $450.
- [Paint protection film](https://filrouge.example/paint-protection-film.html): full front from $1,800, full body from $6,000.
- [Ceramic coating](https://filrouge.example/ceramic-coating.html): $900 to $1,800, usually 1 day.
- [Ceramic window tint](https://filrouge.example/window-tint.html): $350 to $700, usually 1 day.
- [Wheels and tires](https://filrouge.example/wheels.html): priced by quote.
- [Body kits and exhaust](https://filrouge.example/body-kits.html): priced by quote.
